title: Why Do Scientists Do Experiments?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Scientists Do Experiments.
An experiment asks nature the same question, carefully.
Let me show you that in 3D.
If the answer repeats, the idea gets stronger.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
If not, scientists change the idea. That is courage.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A guess is not enough.
The pictures today are a new circuit world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do scientists do experiments.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
